key.name: low-at
key.description: The bar icon turns orange when a connected device's battery is at or below this level.

key.name: critical-at
key.description: The bar icon turns red when a connected device's battery is at or below this level.

key.name: other-devices
key.description: Trackpads, earphones, controllers and other devices from UPower and BlueZ (battery only).

key.name: hidden
key.description: Stable keys (model id, serial or Bluetooth address) of devices hidden from the list and the bar icon.
